title: Solution order file and its rules
goal: One owner-set order across the solution's repositories, validated offline
acceptance: `.solution.json` `order` names a file with an ordered `repo:ID` list (record or step, optional note) between order markers

The profile states the rules: take the first ready item; unlisted work follows each repository's priority; reordering is an owner instruction landed as a PR; never skips a prerequisite or owner decision; references only, never status
`solution.mjs check` validates syntax, known manifest IDs, duplicates and numbering without reaching components; fixtures
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: An order rule that would let an agent skip an owner decision goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed from the coordinator's proposal and its reference implementation. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-25 for 10.12.0: order file, profile rules, offline check, template; review, CI and tag remain.
